newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Muslim Commercial Bank profit soars.
newsitem.headline: Muslim Commercial Bank profit soars.

text.p: Pakistan's Muslim Commercial Bank Ltd said on Monday its pre-tax profit had jumped to 452 million rupees in the first quarter to March from 237 million in the year-earlier period.
"Muslim Commercial Bank has earned 90 percent more profit in the first quarter of 1997, as compared to the corresponding period last year," it said in a statement.

"MCB's deposits at the end of the first quarter of 1997 stood at 111,952 million rupees, advances at 57,607 million, investments at 47,752 million, import at 12,976 million, export at 9,229 million and home remittances at 12,632 million," it said.
